competitor_advantages.point: Chetu states its restaurant POS development practices comply with PCI-DSS, PA-DSS, SOX, Dodd-Frank and Check-21 standards.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Chetu is a custom software development shop that builds bespoke POS and payment integrations for restaurant clients, rather than selling its own packaged POS product.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Indirect competitor — Chetu enables restaurant brands or ISVs to build custom pos/payments integrations in-house instead of buying a packaged platform like Genius's; relevant mainly when a prospect is considering a build-vs-buy decision.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No 2026-specific news found in this pass.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect mentions building custom POS/payments integrations, a firm like Chetu may be the build-side alternative to a packaged Genius solution — frame the conversation around total cost of ownership and maintenance burden of custom builds.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant clients, revenue, or leadership data verified — Chetu is a broad enterprise dev shop, not restaurant-tech-exclusive.
